MARSTAT is not coded 1) or living
with a male partner (no AH-6 RELAR
coded 2); answer was not ascertained
, R refused to report, or R did not
know what her husband/cohabiting
partner was doing most of the time
the previous week (IH-5 SPLSTWK
coded 97, 98, or 99); R's

worked for pay (IH-6 SPPAYJOB coded
2); answer was not ascertained, R
